title: llama.cpp b11003 before b12556 contains an integer overflow in the hrm_text loader load_arch_hparams() that allows…
description: A high-severity integer overflow vulnerability exists in llama.cpp versions from b11003 up to but not including b12556. The flaw occurs in the hrm_text loader's load_arch_hparams() function, where crafted GGUF metadata can bypass block count checks. This allows attackers to supply a GGUF model with layer factors that wrap modulo 2^32, leading to out-of-bounds writes in load_arch_tensors(), corrupting heap memory and potentially enabling code execution.
